Originally thought to be a globular cluster. Canterna & Flower (1977ApJ...212L..57C) subsequently identified its galactic nature.
This author first suggested that this object is a member of the Local Group, but it had previously been cataloged by Corwin et al. (1985sgcc.book.....C).

These authors calculate a new distance to UGC 4879and show that it is on the periphery of the Local Group. While included in Vorontsov-Velyaminov (1959VV....C......0V), earlier references to this object have not been found.
